svg.title: AsyncLLM and the EngineCore startup handshake
svg.desc: The API server binds two ZMQ sockets and starts the EngineCore process. EngineCore sends HELLO and gets the ZMQ addresses back. It then prepares the model, KV cache and scheduler, and sends READY. The API server blocks until READY arrives, so from_vllm_config returns only after the engine is ready. EngineCore then enters run_busy_loop.
